mutations.name: a two-PR Send back sends its note untrimmed
kills: a Ship round with two PRs (TP-3329) ships one PR at its own head and sends the other back with its note, in one submit

mutations.name: a two-PR Send back is on with no note
kills: a Ship round with two PRs (TP-3329) keeps a PR's Send back off until it has a note, and then holds the send
frame feedback on a Ship round with two PRs (TP-3773 S6b) takes a comment on a PR's own frame as its Send back note, never one on the other PR's frame

mutations.name: pressing a PR tab never opens its panel
kills: frame feedback on a Ship round with two PRs (TP-3773 S6b) turns Ship off only for the PR whose own frame is Rejected, and sends the verdict

mutations.name: a sent two-PR round shows the unsent Addressed ticks instead of the sent ones
kills: a Ship round with two PRs (TP-3329) keeps the earlier feedback once sent, with its Addressed tick locked as sent (TP-3824)
